title: Sparkly paper boat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='boatGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c8d6f0'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='sailGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#aec3e8'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- water waves -->
  <path d='M5 74 Q14 68 23 74 Q32 80 41 74 Q50 68 59 74 Q68 80 77 74 Q86 68 95 74' fill='none' stroke='#3ec6e0' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M8 82 Q17 76 26 82 Q35 88 44 82 Q53 76 62 82 Q71 88 80 82 Q88 77 94 82' fill='none' stroke='#2a9fc0' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- boat hull -->
  <path d='M18 66 L82 66 L70 82 L30 82 Z' fill='url(#boatGrad)' stroke='#8fa8cc' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- hull fold line -->
  <path d='M50 66 L50 82' stroke='#b8c8e4' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- hull shading flaps -->
  <path d='M18 66 L30 82 L50 82 L50 66 Z' fill='#eef3fb' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M82 66 L70 82 L50 82 L50 66 Z' fill='#b0c2e0' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- sail -->
  <path d='M50 22 L50 62 L78 62 Z' fill='url(#sailGrad)' stroke='#8fa8cc' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M50 30 L50 62 L64 62 Z' fill='#dfe8f6' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- mast -->
  <path d='M50 20 L50 64' stroke='#9fb6d8' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- small flag -->
  <path d='M50 20 L62 24 L50 28 Z' fill='#ff6fa0'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffe066'>
    <path d='M22 22 L24.5 28 L30 30.5 L24.5 33 L22 39 L19.5 33 L14 30.5 L19.5 28 Z'/>
    <path d='M80 16 L81.8 20.2 L86 22 L81.8 23.8 L80 28 L78.2 23.8 L74 22 L78.2 20.2 Z'/>
    <path d='M86 46 L87.3 49 L90 50.3 L87.3 51.6 L86 54.6 L84.7 51.6 L82 50.3 L84.7 49 Z'/>
    <path d='M14 48 L15.3 51 L18 52.3 L15.3 53.6 L14 56.6 L12.7 53.6 L10 52.3 L12.7 51 Z'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#ffffff'>
    <circle cx='36' cy='14' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='68' cy='36' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='30' cy='42' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='74' cy='56' r='1.6'/>
  </g>
</svg>
